name: Wild Saplings
description: Saplings grow every tree that grows wild, so a forest you cut down can be planted again. A spruce sapling grows a tall, thin pine one time in three, as a third of Taiga's trees are; oak saplings grow big oaks as often as the wild oaks where they're planted are big (a third of the time in Forest and Rainforest, a tenth elsewhere, as in beta), with leaves as full as wild ones. It runs where the world runs, so a server can use it with any client.
authors: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic's AI), at Studio Quire
